## Description

Maximizes the Shannon or Exponential Entropy of asset weight or risk contribution distributions to achieve maximal true effective diversification across asset classes.

## Where it may fit

Uncertain asset correlations, market environment transitions where covariance matrix estimations fail.

## Vehicles

Risk Parity Portfolios, Multi-Asset Endowment Funds.

## Required data

Asset return time series, covariance matrices, optional risk budget vectors.

## Caveats

Entropy maximization can lead to over-allocation in highly volatile illiquid assets without risk constraints.
